mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_event ( id, event_id, run_id, task_id, sub_task_id, turn, step, event_type, agent_id, payload, deleted, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{eventId}, #{runId}, #{taskId}, #{subTaskId}, COALESCE(#{turn}, 1), COALESCE(#{step}, 0), #{eventType}, #{agentId}, #{payload,typeHandler=com.baomidou.mybatisplus.extension.handlers.JacksonTypeHandler}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{deleted}, 0), COALESCE(#{createBy}, 'system'), COALESCE(#{updateBy}, 'system'), COALESCE(#{createTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updateTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{remark} )
